import json
from driver import run
from brute import brute_truth
from validate_witness import validate

INP=[[[3]]]
def A(states, edges, start, fair):
    return run(json.dumps({"op":"audit","inputs":INP,"states":states,"edges":edges,
                           "start":start,"fairness":fair}))[0][0]
def chk(name, states, edges, start, fair, exp_term, exp_safe):
    got = A(states, edges, start, fair)
    P,R,D = 1,1,1
    et = brute_truth(P,R,D,INP,states,[tuple(e) for e in edges],start,
                     [(f["action"],f["mode"]) for f in fair])[1]
    es = brute_truth(P,R,D,INP,states,[tuple(e) for e in edges],start,
                     [(f["action"],f["mode"]) for f in fair])[0]
    errs = validate(P,R,D,INP,states,[tuple(e) for e in edges],start,
                    [(f["action"],f["mode"]) for f in fair], got)
    ok = got["terminates"]==exp_term==et and got["safe"]==exp_safe==es and not errs
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ")+name, got, errs)
    return ok

ND = {"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}     # not done
DN = {"delivered":[[[3]]],"slots":[]}  # done

ok = []
# non-done cycle only reachable THROUGH a done state: no valid counterexample
ok.append(chk("unreachable-through-done",
    [ND, DN, ND],   # 0 non-done start, 1 done, 2 non-done cycle
    [[0,"a",1],[1,"a",2],[2,"a",2]], 0, [], exp_term=True, exp_safe=True))
# same, but with a direct route too
ok.append(chk("reachable-and-done-gated",
    [ND, DN, ND],
    [[0,"a",1],[1,"a",2],[2,"a",2],[0,"a",2]], 0, [], exp_term=False, exp_safe=True))
# fairness action with no edges at all (vacuously satisfied)
ok.append(chk("fairness-no-edges", [ND], [], 0,
    [{"action":"nothing","mode":"weak"},{"action":"else","mode":"strong"}],
    exp_term=False, exp_safe=True))
# weak fairness satisfied by a slightly-too-early disable
ok.append(chk("weak-always-enabled-must-stall",
    [ND, DN], [[0,"x",0],[0,"go",1]], 0, [{"action":"go","mode":"weak"}],
    exp_term=True, exp_safe=True))
print("all:", all(ok))
PYEOF
